description: Use this when the user wants to find a homestay or short stay in South Korea. Filters by area or theme, dates, adult guests, and nightly price in KRW, and returns matching Wehome listings with price, rating, and a link to the listing. Only covers South Korea. Does not make a reservation.

checkin.description: Check-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Give together with checkout to get only available stays.

checkout.description: Check-out date in YYYY-MM-DD format, after checkin.

keyword.description: Area, station, or theme in Korean or English (e.g., 'Hongdae', 'Busan', 'Jeju', 'Hanok')

price_range.description: Semicolon-separated min and max price per night in KRW (e.g., '50000;150000')

sort.description: Sort order: recommend, price_asc (low to high), price_desc (high to low)

name: search_accommodations

alternative_dates.description: Only when dates were given and nothing is free: up to 3 nearby date ranges of the same length that have free stays.

available.description: Number of stays free for these dates

request_to_book.description: True when the host must accept a booking request first. Shown after stays that can be confirmed for the dates.

total_price.description: Total for the given dates, when dates were given

title: Search Wehome stays
